5170-6132-6772-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

539-1462-2034-3821-4679.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-2034-3821-4679.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat

4311-5078-7060-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

394-586-864-2292-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-2292-3125.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-2557-3129-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

560-4550-6797-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-6797-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Ioreth of the Healing House or Kelpie Guide

1432-2085-7786.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If Kelpie Guide has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4518-6823.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or fewer lore counters on it

6575-6577-7664.description:
Cast Clash of the Eikons by paying {G}, removing a lore counter from Esper Terra and then putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's first, second or third chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Summon: Esper Valigarmanda, and then choosing to put a lore counter on the token.
The Summon: Esper Valigarmanda token's first and second chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling Clash of the Eikons from your graveyard and an instant or sorcery from each opponent's graveyard.
Resolve the second trigger, adding {R}{R} and causing you to pay {1} to cast Clash of the Eikons from exile.
Resolve Clash of the Eikons, removing a lore counter from Esper Terra and then putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

1753-3259-4302-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
1753-3259-4302-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

3490-4050-6996-7173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6996-7173.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3213-3903.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling the spell and allowing the player to cast another card exiled by Knowledge Pool without paying its mana cost.
If the player chooses to cast a spell, Boromir triggers, countering that spell since no mana was spent to cast it.

891-3055-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

57-283-4460-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4460-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

654-1409-5647.description:
Activate Roxanne by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Roxanne enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Roxanne.
Resolve the Roxanne trigger, creating a tapped Meteorite token.
When the Meteorite enters, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Meteorite trigger, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the Meteorite.
Activate the Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2438-4677-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2366-3322-4785-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3322-4785-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-4288-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-4288-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

30-147-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-3967.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-3967.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

147-2171-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-6798.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2390-3372-4017.description:
Animate All Will Be One with Zur.
Cast Sunbond by paying {3}{W}, attaching it to All Will Be One.
Gain life.
All Will Be One triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-6633-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6633-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1274-4186-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-5789.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1580-4871-5542.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

542-2585.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.
542-2585.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

348-2178-2577-5632.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Zombie, and at least one additional creature except Gravecrawler or the Zombie.
348-2178-2577-5632.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler and any other creature.
When the creatures die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping itself.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, and causing you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat.

856-3967-4321-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3967-4321-5477.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

687-1628-2012-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Tayam.
Strangleroot Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
687-1628-2012-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability and Necrosynthesis trigger.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Necrosynthesis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Tayam, and both counters from Strangleroot Geist.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Strangleroot Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

565-1954-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}.
565-1954-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}.
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {3}{W}, targeting Palinchron.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
The Palinchron token enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Change of Heart, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

297-1994.notablePrerequisites:
Eldrazi Conscription attached to your commander.
Your commander does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
297-1994.description:
Declare your commander as an attacker.
Rafiq's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Rafiq trigger, giving your commander +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second Rafiq trigger, giving your commander double strike until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using your commander, causing at least twenty-two damage to be dealt.
The opponent loses the game due to being dealt twenty-one or more damage by your commander.

4050-4149-4283-4364.notablePrerequisites: Gisa and Whisper do not have summoning sickness.
4050-4149-4283-4364.description:
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Aurelia, creating at least three 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two Zombies, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Move to your next combat phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, adding {B}.
Repeat.

372-1621-3603.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1621-3603.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Wispweaver Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve Abdel Adrian's enters-the-battlefield ability, exiling Wispweaver Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Wispweaver Angel's enters-the-battlefield ability, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

92-2749-3392.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have 1 life.
Activate Children of Korils by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

880-2783-3470.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
If the creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
